## Step 5: Create an issue

_Welcome to "Introduction to GitHub - Level 2"! :rocket:_

Congratulations on completing Level 1! Now let's dive into more advanced collaboration features. In Level 2, you'll learn how to use GitHub's powerful project management and collaboration tools.

**What is an issue?**: An _[issue](https://docs.github.com/en/issues/tracking-your-work-with-issues/about-issues)_ is a way to track ideas, feedback, tasks, or bugs for work on GitHub. Issues let you break down your work into actionable items and discuss them with collaborators. For more information, see "[About issues](https://docs.github.com/en/issues/tracking-your-work-with-issues/about-issues)".

**Why use issues?**: Issues are essential for project management on GitHub. They help you:
- Track bugs and feature requests
- Organize and prioritize work
- Discuss solutions before implementing them
- Reference related pull requests and commits
- Keep a history of project decisions

### :keyboard: Activity: Create your first issue

Issues are a great way to plan work before you start coding. Let's create an issue to track a new feature you'd like to add.

1. Navigate to the **Issues** tab in your repository's header menu.

   ![screenshot highlighting the issues tab](https://docs.github.com/assets/cb-6111/mw-1440/images/help/repository/repo-tabs-issues.webp)

2. Click the **New issue** button.

3. In the **Title** field, enter `Add favorite color to profile`.

4. In the **Add a description** area, describe what you want to accomplish:
   
   ```
   I'd like to add my favorite color to my profile to make it more personal.
   
   Tasks:
   - [ ] Choose my favorite color
   - [ ] Add a "Favorite Color" section to PROFILE.md
   - [ ] Update the file with my choice
   ```

5. Click **Submit new issue**.

   > **Note:** GitHub will automatically assign the issue a number. Take note of this number as you'll reference it later!

6. Once you've created your issue, Mona will check your work and provide the next step. Keep an eye on the issue comments for feedback!

<details>
<summary>Having trouble? 🤷</summary><br/>

If you don't get feedback, here are some things to check:
- Make sure the issue title matches exactly: `Add favorite color to profile`
- Ensure your issue has a description with the task list

</details>
